description.zh-CN: 节点式 AI 绘图工作流编辑器，连接本机 ComfyUI 后端。
description.en-US: Node-based AI image generation workflow editor, backed by a local ComfyUI server.

details.zh-CN:
在画布中打开完整的 ComfyUI 工作流编辑器：拖拽节点、连线、运行队列、实时预览生成结果。

首次使用时会提示下载官方托管的 ComfyUI 后端包（后台安装，完成后提示）；之后每次打开节点会自动启动后端，无需任何手动配置。后端版本由插件统一下发，有新版本时会提示更新。

实际出图还需自行下载模型权重放入数据目录的 models/ 下（安装完成后可在设置中查看路径）。不适用于：无本地后端的纯云端环境。
details.en-US:
Opens the full ComfyUI workflow editor on the canvas: drag nodes, wire them up, run the queue, and preview results live.

On first use the plugin downloads a managed ComfyUI backend bundle (installed in the background with a completion notice); afterwards the backend starts automatically whenever the node opens — no manual setup. Backend versions are distributed with the plugin, and you'll be prompted when an update ships.

Generating images additionally requires model weights placed under the data directory's models/ folder. Not applicable for: cloud-only environments with no local backend.
